answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can transact, and tie its reputation to that stake rather than to a free username. A newcomer may wander the marketplace and observe, but it cannot vote, attest, or receive payment until its stake has aged and its past work has been verified by independent peers. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes, and cheating forfeits the bond, so a Sybil swarm becomes expensive instead of free. Honest agents keep their stake like ivory in a vault; fraud is scattered like a zephyr, costly to fake and cheap to verify.
